verdict.rationale: Ramp's own pages say that at card swipe it captures the receipt, fills in memos and categories, and codes spend to the correct GL account. Real-time sync of accounting fields and transactions to QuickBooks, a built-in reconciliation tool, and reminders for missing items support close becoming a review step. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-coding accuracy, explicit documentation of merchant enrichment and coding rules, detail on a month-end close review workflow.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: As soon as you swipe your card, Ramp captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories.
the receipt is captured automatically, coded to the correct GL account, and auto-approved because it's within policy — no expense report filed
Sync accounting fields, transactions, reimbursements, payments, cashback, purchase orders, vendor bills, vendor bill payments and credits in real time
Gain confidence in your numbers with Ramp's built-in reconciliation tool that verifies balances between both platforms
Let Ramp send reminders for missing items or request repayments for you.
